_meta.notes: Clerk online-system printout (summary_printer.cfm?ID=654); every figure is machine-printed, nothing handwritten. The summary table has FOUR value columns - 'Total this Period', 'YTD', and a second pair for 'Other Campaign Accounts' which are $0.00 on lines 1 and 2. No checkbox block, amendment question or signature block, so those fields are null; report_date is the system print date. Line 3 ($17,188.53) matches line 7 of the April interim report and the arithmetic is internally consistent. Clerk listing calls this the 'June' report and the form itself says 'Interim Report June 19, 2012'.

contributions.detail: exact (112735.00 = $112,735.00); matches the table's own printed 'Total Contributions $112,735.00'

expenditures.detail: exact (112218.28 = $112,218.28); matches the table's own printed 'Total Expenditures $112,218.28'

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: This form prints NO 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' line - each itemized table carries a single grand total instead, so a per-page subtotal gate cannot fire. The equivalent gate was applied to those printed totals: p2's 37 rows sum to 112735.00 = printed 'Total Contributions $112,735.00'; p3's 19 rows sum to 112218.28 = printed 'Total Expenditures $112,218.28'. Both pass exactly.
itemized.escalation_note: Not needed - this filing is a TYPED clerk-portal printout, not handwriting, and both totals gated exactly on the first full-page read.
itemized.notes: DIFFERENT FORM: this is not the handwritten Schedule A/B packet but a printed slcintranet financialDisclosure summary (footer 'http://slcintranet/financialDisclosure/clerk/summary_printer.cfm?ID=654', dated 6/19/2012), 'Crockett, Mark - Interim Report June 19, 2012', Page 1-3 of 3 plus a 3-page addendum. p1 = cover + Summary (Total this Period / YTD / Other Campaign Accounts columns), p2 = Contributions Received (37 itemized rows + printed total), p3 = Itemized Expenditures Made (19 rows + printed total) followed by the printed statements 'No Contributions Received from other Campaign Accounts reported for this period' and 'No Expenditures of other Campaign Accounts reported for this period'. PDF p4-p6 are 'Elect Mark Crockett - Addendum / O'Hara & Associates, LLC' - a category breakdown (Billboards, Communications, Consulting, Convention Booth, Cookies, Delegate Meeting, Design Work, GOP Donations, Mailer, Voter Meeting, Office Supplies, Parade Supplies, Tele-Town Hall, T-Shirts, SLCo Clerk, Yard Signs) of the O'Hara reimbursement lines flagged '*(See Ad[dendum]'. Those addendum lines are NOT transcribed as expenditure rows: they are a supporting breakdown of amounts already itemized on p3 and transcribing them would double-count. The form has NO mailing-address column, so no donor city/state exists. The In-Kind? column is printed on both tables and is empty on every row. Cover address/phone/fax/email blocks are county-redacted.
